children: Overview
UK medical diagnostics firm's H1 revenue fell 39% yr/yr amid lower orders in most regions
Adjusted EBITDA swung to a loss from a profit a year ago
Gross margin slipped to 66.4% from 67.7% due to lower sales
Outlook
Company still expects full-year sales to be lower than previous yr due to market headwinds
Policy changes in China expected to disrupt demand for several years
Company expects H2 adjusted EBITDA near breakeven and gross margins to hold
Result Drivers
WEAK DEMAND - Co said global economic pressures reduced consumer willingness to spend on premium tests, leading to lower orders in many markets
REGIONAL WEAKNESS - Lower orders in Asia, especially China, Thailand, Korea and Indonesia, were main contributors to revenue decline
COST CUTTING - Co reduced administration costs by £0.5m yr/yr through restructuring efforts
